name: Thompson Savannah
insider_take: Thompson Savannah brings contemporary sophistication to America's most charming historic city, where cobblestone streets meet cutting-edge design in the heart of the Historic District.
whats_special: This boutique gem occupies a prime corner location on Bull Street, offering stunning views of Johnson Square—Savannah's oldest public square dating back to 1733. The hotel's rooftop bar, Fleeting, provides panoramic views over the city's famous tree canopies and historic spires, while the property seamlessly blends modern luxury with Southern hospitality.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Johnson Square for front-row seats to Savannah's daily parade of horse-drawn carriages, street performers, and the mesmerizing Spanish moss swaying in the breeze.
dont_miss: Step outside to discover you're within walking distance of Forsyth Park's iconic fountain, the birthplace of Girl Scout cookies at the Juliette Gordon Low House, and the notorious Mercer Williams House from "Midnight in the Garden of Good and Evil." The hotel's location puts you at the epicenter of Savannah's legendary ghost tours and pub crawls.
pros: Prime Savannah Riverfront Location — Ideally situated along the historic Savannah riverfront, offering stunning water views and walkable access to the city's celebrated squares, dining, and cultural landmarks.

Hyatt Privé Exclusive Benefits — Booked through WhataHotel!, guests enjoy Hyatt Privé perks including daily breakfast for two, room upgrades (when available), early check-in/late check-out, and a hotel credit.

Stylish, Design-Forward Rooms — Thoughtfully curated interiors blending contemporary design with Southern charm, featuring premium bedding, spa-inspired bathrooms, and sweeping river or cityscape views.
Exceptional On-Site Dining & Rooftop Bar — Home to acclaimed dining concepts and a rooftop bar offering panoramic views of the Savannah River, making it a destination in its own right.
World-Class Service & Atmosphere — Thompson Hotels' signature sophisticated hospitality ensures a polished, attentive guest experience with a vibrant yet refined social atmosphere.
cons: Lively Urban Energy — Located in the heart of Savannah's bustling historic district and riverfront, guests seeking a quiet retreat may notice ambient city and social activity noise.
Premium Price Point — As a luxury lifestyle hotel, rates reflect the upscale positioning, making it a higher investment compared to other Savannah accommodations.
